source:
Under the pretense of 'dieting'...
Enjoy a sweety sweet erotic time with your idol lover!

* The pains of dieting are counterbalanced by a happy life with one's lover!
She must undergo and successfully achieve her strict dieting regime in 2 months.
As her trainer and lover, help her along and fill her heart with the power of LOVE!

* This voluptuous and cute heroine is actually... a lewdly naughty girl!?
She's weak to resisting desire, whether it be food, sleep or... SEX!
If it feels goooood, then it doesn't matter. She wants it and she wants it now!?

* So what exactly is, an IDOL?
Cure, slim, not dating any man... Is that REALLLLLY what an idol is?
NO, I object! What makes an idol and IDOL is---!

Thoroughly expressed and developed in this story of love and eros!
Even Komachi the gourmand is highly satisfied with this extra large serving!

translation:
以“减肥”为名……

与偶像恋人享受甜蜜又甜蜜的色情时光吧！

*减肥的痛苦，会被与恋人共度的幸福生活抵消！
她必须在两个月内完成严格的减肥计划。
作为她的教练与恋人，帮助她完成计划，用爱的力量填满她的心吧！

*这个丰满可爱的女主角其实是……放荡淘气的女孩！？
无论是食物、睡眠，还是……性爱！她都无法抵抗欲望。
只要感觉舒服就无所谓。她想要，现在就想要！？

*那么，偶像究竟是什么？
治愈、苗条、不与任何男人交往……偶像真的必须这样吗？
不，我反对！偶像之所以成为偶像，是因为——！

这是一部将爱与色情彻底描绘、发展的故事！
就连美食家小町也对这份超大餐点大为满足！
